content: Rael ire kembei ni irao be ipeebe Yakop le pikin sa som, tana mataana mburmbur pa toono moori. Mi isu to iso pa Yakop ta kembei. Iso: “Kozo kam leŋ pikin sa. Som, to aŋmeete.”
Yakop ileŋ sua ki Rael na, keteene malmal. Tona iso: “Wai! Nio ti Anutu be aŋso mi nu kopom? Nio aŋsekaalu pa peebeŋana?”
To Rael iso: “Ambai. Mi mbesooŋo moori tio Bila imbotmbot i. Kami ma niomru kekeene, bekena ipeebe pio. Naso nio leŋ pikin tomini.”
Tana Rael iur mbesooŋo moori kini ila ki Yakop ma ziru tikeene.
Mi Bila kopoono, to ipeebe Yakop le pikin tomooto ta.
Tabe Rael iso: “Iŋgi Anutu itiiri yo ma leŋ uunu sa isaana som. Pa ileŋ suŋŋana tio mi ikam leŋ pikin tomooto ti.” Tana ipaati be Dan.
Bila kopoono mini, to ipeebe pikin tomooto toro.
Tabe Rael iso: “Nio niamru atoŋ moori amparkam siloogo biibi ma aŋlip pini kek.” Tana ipaata pikin zaana be Naptali.
Lea ire kembei ipeebe pikin mini som, to iur mbesooŋo moori kini Silpa ila ki Yakop be iwe kembei ta kusiini toro.
Silpa kopoono ma ipeebe pikin tomooto ta, tona Lea iso: “Iŋgi koroŋ ambaiŋana.” Tana ipaati be Gat.
Timbotmbot mi Silpa, ta mbesooŋo moori ki Lea na, ipeebe Yakop le pikin tomooto toro.
Tona Lea iso: “Koozi nio menmeen yo biibi. Mi zin moori kar kan ko menmeen zin pio tomini.” Tana Lea ipaata pikin zaana be Aser.

Indeeŋe mazwaana ki kini wit yembutŋana na, Ruben iwwa pa mokleene mi indeeŋe ke pwoono pakan, to ikam ma ila ki naana Lea. (Koroŋ tina tikamam pizin tomtom be timbel zin pa.) Rael ire, to iso pa Lea ma iso: “Ai, kam leŋ sa imar.”
Tamen Lea iso pini: “Wae! Nu ta kam ma kusiŋ leleene pio pe som. Mi iŋgi sombe kam lutuŋ koroŋ kini tiŋgi tomini? Ina ko som.” To Rael iso: “Ambai. Nu kam leŋ sa. Mi mbeŋ koozi to Yakop ima ku.”
Rorou na, Yakop imiili ma ipet kar, to Lea ikoŋuru i mi iso pini ta kembei: “Leŋ. Mbeŋ to nu mar tio. Pa nio aŋgiimu pa ke pwoono ki lutuŋ kek.” Tana mbeŋ na, Yakop ila ki Lea ma ziru tikeene.
Anutu ileŋ suŋŋana ki Lea, tabe kopoono mini to ipeebe pikin tomooto toro ma iwe lamata pa.
Lea isu to iso: “Nio aŋur mbesooŋo moori tio ila ki kusiŋ, tanata Anutu ikam leŋ kadoono ambaiŋana ti.” Tana ipaata pikin zaana be Isaka.
Kaimer to Lea kopoono mini, to ipeebe pikin tomooto toro, ma iwe lamata mi ta pa.
Mi iso: “Anutu ipomoozo kat yo. Iŋgi be kusiŋ Yakop ipakur yo. Pa aŋpeebe le pikin lamata mi ta kek.” Tana ipaata pikin zaana be Zebulun.
Mi kaimer na, Lea ipeebe pikin moori ta. Mi ipaata zaana be Dina.
Kaimer mana, Anutu mataana iŋgal Rael tomini.
Tana ileŋ suŋŋana kini mi ikam ma Rael kopoono. To ipeebe pikin tomooto ta. Mi isu to iso: “Aa buri! Anutu iziiri koŋ miaŋ ma ila lene kek.
Mi leleŋ be Merere ikam leŋ pikin tomooto toro.” Tana ipaata pikin zaana be Yosep.
Mbili ki Yakop timasak
Rael ipeebe Yosep, tona Yakop isu na iso pa Laban ma iso: “Lak. Yok pio be aŋmiili ma aŋla pa toono tio.
Nu ute: Nio aŋbel uraata biibi pu kek. Tana kam kusiŋ bizin mi lutuŋ bizin ma timar be niamŋan amla. Pa kadoono ta ur pio na, aŋposop ma imap kek.”
Tamen Laban iso pini: “Wai zoŋ! Nio aŋso ituru tombotmbot. Pa nio aŋute nu ndomom pio ta Merere ikampewe yo i.
Tana nio leleŋ be zem yo ma la pepe. Sokorei sa ta so lelem pa, na nio ko aŋkam pu mi ituru tombotmbot.”
Yakop iso pini ma iso: “Nu itum ute tau nio aŋbel uraata biibi pu, mi ina uunu tina ta mbili ku timasak ma tiwe boozo.

Muŋgu nu lem mbili boozo pe som. Tamen nio aŋmar aŋbot ku, tabe mbili ku timasak ma tiwe boozo kat. Tana nio ta aŋwe zaala pa kampeŋana ki Anutu ta imarmar pu i. Mi ŋiizi na aŋkam uraata pa ituŋ wal tio?”

To Laban iwi i mini ma iso: “Nu lelem pa sokorei?” Mi Yakop iso: “Kam leŋ koroŋ sa ta buri pepe. Mi parei, ko irao yok pio be aŋla aŋkam leŋ sipsip lutunlutun koskoozoŋan ta boozomen, mi mekmek ŋgaltitiŋan ta boozomen? Ina kadoono tina men ta nio leleŋ pa. Nu sombe yok pa, inako aŋbot mi aŋboro mbili ku mini.
Beso kaimer, ma re mbili sa ta ka mos toro pa mos ru tana, inako nu ute kembei mbili tana, nio aŋkemi. Tana toto zaala ta kembei. Naso nu ute nio tomtom ki sua ŋonoono men.”
Laban ileŋ sua ki Yakop mi iso: “O, ina ambai. Ko takam kembei ta so na.”
Tamen aigule tina Laban imaŋga mi iyo zin mekmek tomooto parrisŋan mi zin mekmek paŋgaara ŋgaltitiŋan mi zin sipsip lutunlutun koskoozoŋan ta boozomen ma iur la ki lutuunu bizin naman be matan pizin.
To lutuunu bizin tikoki zin mbili tana, mi tipa ma irao aigule tel, to timbotmbot su tana. Mi Yakop, ni mataana pizin mbili pakan ta Laban izem zin su kini na.
To Yakop isu mi ikam ke namannaman pakan ta mbitiŋan i, mi izekzek tenten kulin bekena tiwe parrisŋan.
Mi iur se zwor kwon beso zin mbili timar ma tiwin na, tire ke parrisŋan tana.
Beso zin mekmek timar ma tiwin yok, mi tomooto tino zin paŋgaara igarau pa ke namannaman tana, to tipeebe ŋgaltitiŋan mi parrisŋan men.

Mi zin sipsip na, Yakop iur zin ma timbot ndel pizin mekmek. Mi indeeŋe ta zin tomooto tikamam be tino zin paŋgaara, to itooro zin ma matan ila kizin sipsip parrisŋan mi koskoozoŋan ki Laban. Ikamam ta kembei, tabe ipamasak mbili kini ma tiwe boozo kat. Mi ikam zin ma timbot ndel pa Laban kini.
Tana indeeŋe zin mbili tumkatŋan tikamam be tino zin paŋgaara na, Yakop iurur ke namannaman parrisŋan se zwor kwoono.
Tamen indeeŋe zin mbili koŋkoŋŋan tisombe tino na, itatkewe ke namannaman tana pizin. Tabe molo som mi, Yakop le mbili tumkatŋan men. Mi ki Laban na koŋkoŋŋan.
Ina zaala tina ta Yakop iwe mbio uunu pa. Ni irao kat pa mekmek, sipsip, mburu, mbesooŋo, kamel, doŋki, mi koroŋ ta boozomen.
